top_story.headline: Quiet weekend on the ethics and lobbying filings
top_story.dek: No new foreign-agent registrations or terminations, no new lobbying registrations, and no newly flagged ethics filings.
paragraphs: The lobbying filings that did post were third-quarter activity reports: 79 of the 87 filings posted since October 10 were routine reports, and Holland & Knight LLP alone accounted for 27 of the 87. The automated checks found no new presidential trades and no newly quiet prolific traders.

sections.headline: No significant ethics filings flagged this period
paragraphs: No new divestitures, terminations, or other flagged filings were identified in the Office of Government Ethics database during the reporting window of October 8–10, 2026. The OGE system was fully operational and reachable.

sections.headline: No new or terminated foreign-agent registrants
paragraphs: The DOJ FARA e-file system's New Registrants report and Terminated Registrants report both showed zero entries for October 10–11, 2026.

sections.headline: Only previously reported candidate filings in the lookback window
paragraphs: Every House and Senate filing since October 8 had already appeared in a prior edition: House candidate reports from Thurman Bill Bartie (TX14), Rosemary Pino (NJ09) and Ritesh Tandon (CA17), and the Senate candidate report from Jade Simmons (Texas). No periodic transaction reports (stock trades) were filed in the window. The Senate candidate report lists $250,000 in self-employment income from Jade Media Global, LLC. of Kingwood, Texas, no reportable assets, and educational and credit-card debts, per the filing.

sections.headline: No new lobbying registrations; 87 quarterly filings, mostly routine
paragraphs: The Senate lobbying database showed no new registrations since October 10. It did show 87 other filings: 79 third-quarter reports, 4 third-quarter no-activity reports, and 4 terminations or amendments. Holland & Knight LLP filed 27 of them, mostly for local governments and utilities, followed by Valiant Strategies LLC and Cornerstone Government Affairs, Inc. with 11 each. The terminations and amendments are below.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
